name: Mango-II fluorescent RNA aptamer bound to EKM
preparationNotes: Initial runnable preparation uses RNA chain A and ligand EKM chain A from RCSB PDB 6C64. Crystallographic K ions were removed for this first MacVina stacking-focused case because the current aptamer scorer has no potassium-specific term. Open Babel generated PDBQT files; ligand aromatic perception emitted a kekulization warning, so this case remains parsed rather than contact_reviewed.
source: RCSB PDB 6C64; HARIBOSS RNA-small-molecule complex example.
notes: HARIBOSS expansion case promoted to parsed with local ignored PDBQT inputs. Ligand EKM is a fluorescent dye-like heteroaromatic ligand bound in chains A and B; this case uses the chain A instance. Use as an early Mango-II base-stacking benchmark after reviewing contacts against the source structure/paper.
